Why Astron Services

Precision Comfort, Every Visit

Locally Owned & Operated

Astron Services is based right here in Wichita, not a franchise or call center dispatching from out of state.

RUUD Authorized Dealer

We install high-efficiency RUUD heating and cooling systems backed by manufacturer warranties and professional installation.

Honest Pricing, No Hidden Fees

You get a clear, honest price before any work begins. No surprise charges, no pressure.

Licensed & Insured Technicians

Every technician is licensed and insured, bringing precision and professionalism to every job.
